responsibility: Provides rustc_typeck’s AST-to-type conversion layer, centered on the `AstConv` interface and core lowering logic that turns HIR type syntax, paths, trait objects, associated items, bounds, lifetimes, and generic arguments into `rustc_middle::ty` forms. Within that role, `generics` validates and interprets generic argument lists against declared generics and language restrictions, while `errors` defines and emits the diagnostics for conversion failures such as invalid generic usage, unresolved associated types, missing bindings, and misuse of `Fn`-family traits. Together these files implement and diagnose the semantic checking needed while translating parsed type syntax into the compiler’s internal type representation.
